results.title: Brace Your Heart
results.overview: In a remote Sámi village high in the mountains, 20-year-old Ejva inherits her late father's reindeer herd. As she struggles to keep the herd thriving, local leader Heaika develops romantic feelings for her, and though hesitant, she feels compelled to accept. But everything changes when Nejla, Heaika's cousin, arrives, and Ejva discovers true love for the first time. Betrayed and jealous, Heaika reacts harshly, leaving Ejva with a condition that makes her hands shake uncontrollably, threatening her ability to care for the herd. Now, Ejva must find a way to reclaim control over her life and her future.

results.title: Gaja's World 3
results.overview: GAJA'S WORLD 3 is a family action comedy that introduces us to 16-year-old Gaja and introduces us to her unusual family and the world she lives in. Gaja starts high school, meets new friends, experiences her first love, but nothing is as it seems. When her mother, who is leading Doctors Without Borders on a special mission in a war zone, is kidnapped, Gaja must show all her ingenuity and courage. In the end, she proves what really counts in life, because it is never too late to change for the better.

results.title: Bayside Shakedown N.E.W.
results.original_title: 踊る大捜査線 N.E.W. メトロポリスを駆け抜けろ！
results.overview: In 2026, Tokyo is rocked by a series of increasingly dangerous crimes, including a kidnapping in which the perpetrators threaten to bomb the city unless a ransom is delivered—and inexplicably choose veteran detective Shunsaku Aoshima as the courier. At the same time, a string of murders involving 3D-printed guns leads to the theft of a deadly virus from one of the victims, followed by a threat to release it across Tokyo. Newly assigned to the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department’s First Investigative Division, Aoshima and his colleagues race across the city to unravel the connected cases and prevent catastrophe.

results.title: The Last Stop
results.overview: A pizza delivery turns into a deadly encounter when a routine stop at a strange apartment reveals a hidden pattern of violence and obsession.

results.title: Immersed
results.overview: Hassan Karkhaneh, a veteran detective on the verge of promotion, is faced with the case of a woman who vanished following a suspicious accident. Despite psychological pressure and systemic opposition, he grows suspicious of the mysterious Maahak and launches a private investigation. Caught between the law, his conscience, and a mental breakdown, Hassan must decide how far he is willing to go to save Leila.

results.title: Golden Bullet
results.overview: A crime thriller story set in Serbia.

results.title: The Assassination of Charlie Kirk
results.overview: The assassination of Charlie Kirk exposes decades of polarisation, revealing how media, power and fear fractured America.

results.title: Other Voices Presents: Foo Fighters
results.overview: Other Voices presents a legendary night of music as Foo Fighters bring their stadium anthems to St James’ Church, An Daingean.

results.title: Amaretti
results.overview: When septuagenarian Lennie's reality is devastated by the discovery of a prolonged, pernicious crime committed against her by her own son, an unexpected connection helps her to begin a journey towards re-forging her fractured identity.

results.title: She Was Here
results.overview: Heather O’Rourke captured hearts as Carol-Anne in the Poltergeist films, a bright light destined for greatness. Her sudden passing at just 12 years old left the world stunned and searching for answers. She Was Here looks beyond the headlines and rumors to honor the girl behind the role: her life, her spirit, and the legacy she left behind.

results.title: The Awake
results.overview: Vision becomes the primary anchor to reality for patients in the later stages of motor neurone disease – also known as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, or ALS. Poetic, abstract dance evokes ALS patients’ rich, heightened consciousness as everyday objects dissolve under the weight of illness: a motionless wheelchair; drifting curtains; a dining table for two; a fish in its bowl.

results.title: Fortune Tellers Inc.
results.overview: Mai, now ready to enter adulthood, ventures out to the magical Fortune Tellers Inc. where mystical creatures reveal her future. However, after every reading, the object of the prediction materialises to Mai’s astonishment.

results.title: Театр в кино: Принцесса цирка
results.overview: Early 20th century, Paris. Mr. X, a mysterious circus performer never seen without a mask, stirs hearts and stirs rumors in Parisian society. The beautiful Theodora, a young, wealthy widow, is the envy of all high society. To win the heart of this brilliant socialite, circus talent alone is not enough. And does her love really matter to someone who has chosen solitude and decided to hide their face forever behind a mask?

results.title: Magudam
results.overview: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

results.title: Leo and Tig. The Road to Baikal
results.original_title: Лео и Тиг. Дорога на Байкал
results.overview: Leo and Tig set off on a journey to faraway Lake Baikal to bring back home the lost seal pup named Lufi. Along the way, they make new friends with Zhu, a red panda, and Wukong the Monkey King. They also cross paths with the evil chieftain of a horse herd Tengri-Khan, who wants to seize the seal. For whoever brings Lufi home will be granted any wish by the Master of Baikal – the great dragon Lusud.

results.title: Wind Beneath the Wings
results.overview: Anica (60) resists her ongoing chemotherapy while perceiving her daughter’s care as an assault on her dignity. Vlatko (60) is an alcoholic and a loner, completely written off by his work colleagues. Filled with mutual contempt, Anica and Vlatko separated long ago and seemingly no longer communicate. On their drawn-out paths toward oblivion, they search for an ally who will hear their desperate cry for the will to live.

results.title: Mooncake
results.overview: When a closeted Chinese-Australian cellist hijacks her family's Moon Festival to come out through song, her confession detonates buried secrets that force her entire family to choose between tradition and truth. Lydia, a reserved Chinese-Australian cellist, is harbouring a secret so terrifying it makes her physically sick-she's a lesbian, and coming out could get her disowned. When her father returns home from working overseas for the Moon Festival, her girlfriend insists this is her only chance, but Lydia is paralysed by fear. With unexpected support from her Spielberg wannabe younger brother, Lydia abandons her traditional cello performance to sing a raw confession to her entire family. Her coming out fractures the room-but more devastatingly, it triggers the revelation of another long-buried family secret.

results.title: Go to Sleep
results.overview: A recently separated man newly living alone discovers that he is sleepwalking at night, and as he records his activities, he discovers questionable behaviors and the presence of another mysterious figure.

results.title: Aontas
results.overview: Three unlikely women rob a rural Irish Credit Union. A backwards chronology unravels what went wrong.
